ai_summary: GST registration and return filing portal; mandatory above turnover thresholds; input tax credit enabled.
ai_explanation: Businesses above the turnover threshold register for GST to get a GSTIN, charge tax, and claim input tax credit. Returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) are filed online. Registration is free but late returns incur fees. Aadhaar authentication is used.
common_questions: How do I register for GST?
